title: dolomiaea cooperi
intro: Dolomiaea cooperi, commonly known as the Cooper's dolomiaea or Himalayan pennywort, is a type of flowering plant in the family Apiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dolomiaea cooperi include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antiseptic properties.
